#0 world — the world drifts into the glass: ≡ (records) and ⚙ (mediation) carry attract fields pulling toward the mirror ring; the ring itself becomes the returned figure (☺) — the mirror receiving a world and handing back a likeness in one gesture; pointer attract gentle; duration 14 — the gathering takes time.

#1 funhouse — the hall of mirrors (line layout); the figure's ☺→☠→☺ sequence kept (captivation as repetition) and the living gaze ✧ occupied into ◉ — organs of sight staged as the gaze's own transformation; turbulence shimmers on an LFO (auto-fascination); circulation negative (suction into the glass); pointer attract/implode — captivation.

#2 measure — ring layout (the measure's circuit); the self-fulfilling disc grows and darkens (prediction producing its object); ⊢ shoved to the frame's edge and dimmed (the poor fit expelled through the image's own terms); pointer repel/shove — the gauge excludes.

#3 initiated — THE 3D SCENE. z is the depth of deference: the disclosed formation ≡ at mid-depth, ↓ walking from z +0.3 to z −0.3 (answer → task → evaluator → commission, each step deeper and warmer), ☰ (the Chang appointment) high at z +0.4, ∅ (kenosis, owned limit) deepest at z −0.45 — the vocation's ground; depth occlusion with a warm dark tint; pointer attract/pulse — invitation, not demand (a demand would repeat the capture).

#5→0 return — the changed relation settles small and faint (used, examined, corrected, set down); the three-instruments comparison bright; the institution's ⚖ gains its own attract (it enters the same return); 1/0 bright at the rim; field opens (dispersion 0.12, circulation 0.4), auto-follow breathes pointer strength; pointer near-still. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's world drifted into the glass and the glass answered with a figure that moved first; #5→0 keeps the ring but cleared and small, with ⚖ and 1/0 outside it — the measures returned to their makers, the relation to likeness changed; the exteriorised ≡ of #0 answers at #3 where the instrument discloses its own formation first. The funhouse's imploding pointer becomes the return's near-still attract: capture released into company.
